automatable_note: A jumper is fitted on the two gold contacts before power is applied and pulled off after the ESC's first tone sequence. The bench has no actuator for the jumper, so a person does both; the run asks for each step. An optional arming switch can replace the jumper on the two gold contacts.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on the two gold contacts.
manual.action_de: Jumper auf die beiden Goldkontakte stecken.

manual.action: Pull the jumper off after 2 s or the three-tone sequence.
manual.action_de: Jumper nach 2 s oder dem Dreiklang abziehen.

entry.confirm_signal: Tone sequence after the 2 s wait.
steps: Operator: fit the jumper on the programming contacts. Connect the motor if tones are to be audible.
Transmitter and receiver on. Throttle to brake (stick back); mode 3 and 6: motor-off position.
Wait 2 s or until the ESC sounds its tone sequence.
Mode series sounds; mode 7 is reached at the 7-fold signal.
Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds. Mode 6: then stick to brake.
Control output repeats the mode. Disconnect power.

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Throttle to full during the wanted series.

scheme.description: Jumper procedure with a 2 s wait. Mode N is N tones.

values.name: APM: reset, stick range learned at every power-up
Glider: brake about 0.5 s, cutoff 0.8 V per cell, RPM limit 50,000 at 4 poles, optional separate motor-off position
Motor plane / boat: brake off, cutoff off

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.
Gap between tones inside one mode series in ms is not stated.
Pause between two mode series in ms is not stated.
Whether the mode series loops until a mode is selected is not stated.
Time window in ms for moving the throttle to full after the wanted series is not stated.
Duration in ms of the three-tone sequences (ascending and descending) is not stated.
Exact timing of the 'wait 2 s or until the tone sequence' step is not stated beyond the 2 s minimum; the end of the wait is the ESC's tone sequence.
Page numbers cover both language sides; the layout is two-column and duplicated.
Voltage in mV is not stated; cells are NiCd.
BEC presence is not stated in the text read.
notes: The 3SL manual lists modes 1 to 7; the BEAT successor adds mode 8.
Mode 6 is programmed with the stick at motor-off in the middle (Kontronik_3SL.pdf p.16 DE, p.6 EN). It carries entry_throttle mid, so stick programming does not store it from the brake position.
Mode 6 moves the stick to the brake position (back) after the full-throttle selection (Kontronik_3SL.pdf p.16 DE, p.6 EN): after_select min, made STORE after the selection; the manual gives no time.
